build_VCTPipeline: build a VCTPipeline with analysis and synthesis transforms for video compression
run_compress_video: run compress_video on a VideoData batch to get compressed scenes and bit counts
run_decompress_video: run decompress_video with frames shape and bottleneck args to reconstruct video frames
run_forward: run the VCTPipeline forward pass on a VideoData batch to get reconstructions and likelihoods
run_compute_rate: run compute_rate on scenes likelihoods tensor to calculate bits per frame or total
